# fig a. phyla abundance
```{r}
df <- read.csv("multi_kingdom_main_phyla_long.csv")

df_bac   <- df %>% filter(Kingdom == "Bacteria")
df_fungi <- df %>% filter(Kingdom == "Fungi")
df_algae <- df %>% filter(Kingdom == "Algae")

make_plot <- function(dat) {
  dat$Sample <- factor(dat$Sample, levels = unique(dat$Sample))
  
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Taxa)) +
    
    geom_col() +
    
    facet_grid(rows = NULL, cols  = vars(Habitat),  scales = "free_x", space  = "free_x") +
    
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_pool) +

    theme_bw() +
    
    theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = element_rect(color = "black"), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}

pa1   <- make_plot(df_bac)
pa2 <- make_plot(df_fungi)
pa3 <- make_plot(df_algae)

pa1
pa2
pa3

```

# fig b. aPCoA
```{r}
abu<- read.csv("bac_otutab_paired.csv", row.names=1)

abu<- t(abu)

dim(abu)

design <- read.csv("bac_metadata_paired.csv", row.names = 1)

bray <- vegdist(abu, method = 'bray')

opar<-par(mfrow=c(1,2),
          mar=c(5, 5, 5, 5),
          mgp=c(2, 0.5, 0),
          oma=c(0, 0, 0, 2))

result <- aPCoA(bray~Region,
                design,
                maincov=Habitat)

par(opar)

```

```{r}

otu.adonis=adonis(bray~Habitat,data = design,distance = "bray")

aPCoA.score <-result$plotMatrix

plotdata <- data.frame(aPCoA.score[,1:2], design$Habitat)

colnames(plotdata)  <- c("aPCoA1","aPCoA2","Group")

centroid <- aggregate(plotdata[,1:2],by=list(plotdata$Group), FUN = mean)
centroid

plotdata2 <- merge(plotdata, centroid, by.x = "Group", by.y ="Group.1", 
                   all.x = T,suffixes = c("",".centroid"),)

head(plotdata2)

pb1 <- ggplot(data = plotdata2, aes(aPCoA1, aPCoA2, color = Group)) +
  
    stat_ellipse(data = plotdata2, geom = "polygon", level = 0.5,
               linetype = 1, linewidth = 0.1, 
               aes(fill = Group, x = aPCoA1, y = aPCoA2),
               alpha = 0.2, show.legend = T) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend= aPCoA1.centroid, yend= aPCoA2.centroid, color = Group),
alpha=0.6,size = 0.5,show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = col_pla_env) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = col_pla_env) + 
  labs(title = "Bacteria",
       x = "aPCoA1 13.68%", y = "aPCoA2 10.55%") + #解释率
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

pb1


```

# fig c. qpcr result
```{r}
library(ggbeeswarm)

qpcr <- read.csv("qPCR_data.csv")

pc <- ggplot(qpcr, aes(x = Habitat, y = Number_of_cells_per_unit_mass)) +
  
  geom_violin(aes(fill = Habitat,color= Habitat), trim = F, alpha = 0.66)+ 
  
  scale_y_log10() +
  
  geom_quasirandom(aes(color = Habitat), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.66, shape = 19) +
  
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1),color = "white",
               geom = "pointrange", size = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = col_pla_env) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_pla_env) + 
  
  facet_wrap(~ Kingdom, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(x = "Habitat", y = "Number_of_cells_per_unit_mass") +
  
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", paired = T,
                     comparisons=list(c("Environment", "Plastisphere")), 
                     aes(label = ..p.signif..), step.increase = 0) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

pc

```


# fig d. taxa abundance Wilcoxon test
```{r}
df <- read.csv("scaled_taxonomic_abundance_diff_results.csv")

head(df)

order_list <- c("Alphaproteobacteria", "Betaproteobacteria", "Gammaproteobacteria",
                "Deltaproteobacteria", "Actinobacteria", 
                "Bacteroidetes", "Firmicutes", "Acidobacteria", "Ascomycota",
                "Basidiomycota", "Chytridiomycota", "Rozellomycota", "Ochrophyta",
                "Dinoflagellata", "Cryptomonadales", "Prymnesiophyceae", 
                "Florideophycidae",	"Kathablepharidae", "Cercozoa")


df <- df %>%
  mutate(Taxa = factor(Taxa, levels = order_list))

kingdom_colors <- c("Bacteria" = "#ECD1D1", "Fungi" = "#ABD7EC", "Algae" = "#FFDD8E")

pd <- ggplot(df, aes(Taxa, -estimate)) +
  geom_rect(data = df %>% distinct(Taxa, Kingdom) %>% group_by(Kingdom) %>% 
              summarize(xmin = min(as.numeric(Taxa)) - 0.5, xmax = max(as.numeric(Taxa)) + 0.5),
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Kingdom), alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = -conf.low, ymin = -conf.high, color = level)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = -estimate, color = level), size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = -conf.low, label = p.adj.signif, color = level), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = kingdom_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#EFB04B", "#B6BBBD", "#7B9DBB"),
                     limits = c("enriched", "ns", "depleted")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey") +
  labs(y = "Effect Size", x = "Main taxa") +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
pd

```


# fig e. alpha diversity

```{r}
df3 <- read.csv("alpha_diversity_diff_results.csv")

head(df3)

order_list <- c("Bacteria_Richness", "Bacteria_Shannon", "Fungi_Richness", "Fungi_Shannon", "Algae_Richness", "Algae_Shannon")

df3 <- df3 %>%
  mutate(index = factor(index, levels = order_list))

kingdom_colors <- c("Bacteria" = "#ECD1D1", "Fungi" = "#ABD7EC", "Algae" = "#FFDD8E")

pe <- ggplot(df3, aes(index, -estimate)) +
  
  geom_rect(data = df3 %>% distinct(index, Kingdom) %>% group_by(Kingdom) %>% 
              summarize(xmin = min(as.numeric(index)) - 0.5, xmax = max(as.numeric(index)) + 0.5),
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Kingdom), alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = -conf.low, ymin = -conf.high, color = level)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = -estimate, color = level), size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = -conf.low, label = p.adj.signif, color = level), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = kingdom_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#EFB04B", "#B6BBBD", "#7B9DBB"),
                     limits = c("enriched", "ns", "depleted")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey") +
  
  labs(y = "Effect Size", x = "Index") +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
pe

```


# fig f. phyla species richness

```{r}
df2 <- read.csv("scaled_taxonomic_richness_diff_results.csv")

head(df2)

order_list <- c("Alphaproteobacteria", "Betaproteobacteria", "Gammaproteobacteria",
                "Deltaproteobacteria", "Actinobacteria", 
                "Bacteroidetes", "Firmicutes", "Acidobacteria", "Ascomycota",
                "Basidiomycota", "Chytridiomycota", "Rozellomycota", "Ochrophyta",
                "Dinoflagellata", "Cryptomonadales", "Prymnesiophyceae", 
                "Florideophycidae",	"Kathablepharidae", "Cercozoa")


df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(Taxa = factor(Taxa, levels = order_list))

kingdom_colors <- c("Bacteria" = "#ECD1D1", "Fungi" = "#ABD7EC", "Algae" = "#FFDD8E")


pf <- ggplot(df2, aes(Taxa, -estimate)) +

  geom_rect(data = df2 %>% distinct(Taxa, Kingdom) %>% group_by(Kingdom) %>% 
              summarize(xmin = min(as.numeric(Taxa)) - 0.5, xmax = max(as.numeric(Taxa)) + 0.5),
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = Kingdom), alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = -conf.low, ymin = -conf.high, color = level)) +

  geom_point(aes(y = -estimate, color = level), size = 2) +

  geom_text(aes(y = -conf.low, label = p.adj.signif, color = level), vjust = -0.5) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = kingdom_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#EFB04B", "#B6BBBD", "#7B9DBB"),
                     limits = c("enriched", "ns", "depleted")) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey") +
  labs(y = "Effect Size", x = "Main taxa") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

pf
```
